dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable selectors, conflicts, help, and the no-selector path are implemented in the command flow.
evidence: product.diff item_list.go flag and PreRunE hunks

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Name resolution is case-insensitive, preserves canonical field names for headers, and emits sorted actionable candidates.

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: The initial item query supplies fields; continuation requests occur only for selected columns and loop from the returned cursor, with errors returned before rendering.

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All specified scalar, structured, and multi-value variants are rendered, with empty fallback and CR/LF normalization.
evidence: product.diff item_list.go formatFieldValue and normalizeTableText hunk

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Selected canonical headers and one cell per selected field are appended per row; values are matched by field node ID and absent values yield empty cells.
evidence: product.diff item_list.go printResults and fieldValueForID hunk

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Selection and field-pagination failures return before exporter/table output; the change uses the existing project query types and command path without altering the no-field behavior.
evidence: tests.log: focused Go test command exited 0
